issues.failure_explanation: The statement lets the discrete initial concentration $\uh(0)=\uh_0$ be an arbitrary element of $\Vhq$ (the scheme \eqref{dG semi-discrete wave-adv diff system} only requires $(\ph_0,\ph_1,\uh_0)\in(\Vh)^3$), yet it asserts $\Ltwonorm{u(t)-\uh(t)}{\Omega}^{2} + \int_{0}^{t} \dgseminorm{u-\uh}^{2} \ds \lesssim h^{2q}$. The proof tests the error equation with $\ehu$ and integrates in time; the resulting energy inequality contains the initial term $\tfrac12\|\ehu(0)\|^2_{L^2(\Omega)} = \tfrac12\|\uh_0-\Ih u_0\|^2$, which the proof silently absorbs into the $h^{2q}$ right-hand side. This absorption is valid only if $\|u_0-\uh_0\|_{L^2(\Omega)}\lesssim h^{q}$ (e.g. $\uh_0 = \Ih u_0$, as explicitly assumed for the pressure in Theorem thm:wellposedness nonlin via $(\ph_0,\ph_1) = (\Ih p_0, \Ih p_1)$). For a general $\uh_0\in\Vhq$ the claimed estimate is false (e.g. take $\uh_0$ with $\|u_0-\uh_0\|_{L^2}\approx 1$), so the stated guarantee does not follow from the stated hypotheses.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add to Theorem thm: full model concentration the hypothesis that the discrete initial concentration interpolates the exact one, $\uh_0 = \Ih u_0$ (or satisfies $\|u_0-\uh_0\|_{L^2(\Omega)}\lesssim h^{q}$), mirroring the choice $(\ph_0,\ph_1) = (\Ih p_0, \Ih p_1)$ of Theorem thm:wellposedness nonlin; with this hypothesis the proof as written is complete.
issues.overall_effect: As written, the concentration well-posedness statement survives (the concentration equation is linear for fixed $\ph$), but the advertised error estimate $\Ltwonorm{u(t)-\uh(t)}{\Omega}^{2} + \int_{0}^{t} \dgseminorm{u-\uh}^{2} \ds \lesssim h^{2q}$ fails for discrete initial data not approximating $u_0$; the subsequent unlabelled overshoot bound $\| \uh \|_{L^{\infty}(\Omega)} \leq \| u \|_{L^{\infty}} + C(h^{q-d/2}+h^{q+1-d/2})$, which cites this theorem, is likewise unreliable without the missing hypothesis.
issues.title: Theorem on the coupled system omits the hypothesis on the discrete initial concentration
issues.why_classification: A one-line addition of the standard initial-data condition $\uh_0 = \Ih u_0$ (already used for the pressure in Theorem thm:wellposedness nonlin) makes the proof complete; the scheme, the $h^{2q}$ rates, and the advertised scope all survive unchanged.
